purpose: Targeted primary-source retrieval and exact source/slug reconciliation. Distinguish official contest statements, official judge source metadata, secondary metadata, and absent evidence.

records.title: Build Dependencies
records.finding: Prior Virtual Judge metadata labels this as NWERC 2015 Practice and names Jeroen Bransen. Retrieved the complete 24-page NWERC 2015 official contest statement PDF from the Codeforces contest materials page and inspected its problem index and all problem headings: the 11 official problems are Assigning Workstations, Better Productivity, Cleaning Pipes, Debugging, Elementary Math, Flight Plan Evaluation, Guessing Camels, Hole in One, Identifying Map Tiles, Jumbled Communication, and Kitchen Combinatorics. Build Dependencies is not among them. This does not disprove a separate practice-session association, but the specific source label is not corroborated by the official main-contest packet. No Build Dependencies statement was captured; keep source attribution unresolved and do not substitute another year's same-title task.

sourceEvidence.observation: NWERC 2015 contest materials lists an English statements PDF.
Full NWERC 2015 statement packet inspected; problem index contains 11 problems and no Build Dependencies.
Lists the NWERC 2015 official problemset source URL.

records.nextGate: Retrieve the distinct NWERC 2015 practice-session problem package or an authoritative Kattis source-page export that explicitly lists builddeps; inspect the original statement and constraints.
